data.sub: Pantnagar airport ke vistarikaran ko manjoori mil gayi hai.

chat.say: Ab ghar aana aur aasan ho jayega.
Toh ab travel karna aur fast hoga.

data.asar: Air connectivity behtar hone se safar aasan hoga.
data.caption:
Pantnagar airport ke vistarikaran ko lekar badi khabar.
• ₹375.33 crore se banega naya runway
• 3,000 meter lamba hoga runway
• SEIAA ne di manjoori
Safarnama ab aur bhi shandar hone wala hai.
Apne us dost ko tag karo jo flight se safar karna pasand karta hai!
